summary: Iteration 3 - Project reservations (reserveringen) feature. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases PASS in test_reservations.py covering CRUD + RBAC + stock semantics + concurrency. POST /api/reservations admin-only (monteur & magazijn 403 verified); physical unchanged, reserved +qty, available = fysiek - gereserveerd (verified via explicit GET /api/articles/{id} with physical_stock=100 reserved=25 available=75); quantity > available returns 409 with Dutch message containing 'beschikbaar'; same client_request_id twice returns the SAME reservation (idempotent). PATCH /api/reservations/{id} admin-only; increase beyond available -> 409 with reserved unchanged; decrease frees available atomically; PATCH on closed reservation -> 409. POST /release and /complete admin-only, reserved returned to available, status becomes 'opgeheven' / 'voltooid'. GET /api/reservations/{id} returns events history including aangemaakt, gewijzigd, opgeheven actions. GET /api/reservations?article_id=&status=actief|afgesloten|alle filters correctly and is visible to ALL roles (admin, magazijn, monteur). POST /api/mutations afboeken with reservation_id (monteur allowed): physical -10 -> 90, reserved -10 -> 15, available stays 75 (NO double deduction); reservation reaching 0 is auto-set to 'voltooid'. Free afboeken > available -> 409. Ontvangst/retour/correctie all still function. Concurrency: 10 parallel reservations of qty=3 on stock=20 article -> exactly 6 succeeded (201) and 4 got 409 (6*3=18 <= 20); reserved_stock<=20 enforced atomically, available never negative, physical unchanged. Frontend (390x844 mobile): Admin on /artikel/TEST-RES-1 shows Fysiek/Gereserveerd/Beschikbaar card (65/0/65 before, 65/7/58 after reserve); + Reserveren button (article-reserve-button) opens reservation-sheet with project-input, qty-input, note-input, save-button; availability hint 'Beschikbaar na reservering: 58 stuks' is live-computed; over-reserve (999) blocks and shows BOTH reservation-availability-hint ('Onvoldoende beschikbaar: maximaal 65 stuks te reserveren') AND reservation-error box after save ('Onvoldoende beschikbare voorraad: er zijn 65 stuks beschikbaar voor deze reservering'). Edit sheet shown on reservation-row click with Voltooien + Opheffen buttons (visible in screenshot) and inline confirm flow. Mutaties tab shows 'Reserveringen' segment (mutations-view-reserveringen) with Actief/Afgesloten/Alle chips (all three testIDs present). Monteur: on same article detail sees 65/7/58 stock correctly, NO article-reserve-button, NO article-edit-button; clicking a reservation-row opens read-only sheet with ZERO save/complete/release buttons; in /mutaties tab segment-reserveringen IS visible with Actief/Afgesloten/Alle chips but NO reservations-add-button. Monteur can open mutation sheet (Mutatie boeken) which contains mutation-reservation-picker with mutation-reservation-none chip + mutation-reservation-{id} chips when active reservations exist. No React Native red screens; only pre-existing non-blocking warnings 'shadow* style props deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated'. No deprecated expo packages. All PRD items (admin-only mutation, read-only view for monteur/magazijn, available = fysiek - gereserveerd, afboeken via reservation does not double-deduct, free afboeken bounded by available, concurrency safety) verified end-to-end.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py reserve_stock uses atomic $expr {$gte: [{$subtract: [physical_stock, reserved_stock]}, qty]} with findOneAndUpdate - correctly prevents race conditions (concurrency test proved max 18/20 reserved on 10 parallel workers).

server.py afboeken-on-reservation uses two-step atomic approach: article $inc with $expr guard first, then reservations findOneAndUpdate with status+quantity match, and rollback (reverse $inc) if the reservation update loses optimistic lock - good design.
server.py close_reservation uses optimistic lock on {status: 'actief', quantity: r.quantity} - prevents stale updates; event log records 0 as quantity_after which maps nicely to history UI.
reservation_out() includes available_stock derivation only via article; the reservation itself has quantity+consumed_quantity+original_quantity - correct separation.

Idempotency: unique index on client_request_id (partial) + find-first path in create endpoint provides safe retry; existing-doc path returns the SAME id - verified in test_idempotent_client_request_id.

server.py line 1072 raises 422 on empty project but ReservationUpdateIn already has min_length=1 on project; 422 is actually produced by pydantic before reaching the handler, so the extra guard is a dead branch (minor, not a bug).
Minor: on PATCH when only project/note change (delta==0) the branch at line 1089 still requires match on quantity for optimistic lock - good.

Reservations.tsx line 337 renders history only for non-actief status; for an active reservation the history is NOT shown in UI even though GET /reservations/{id} returns events. Consider showing events for active reservations too for admin audit trail (minor UX; not in acceptance criteria).
